description: ASPset-510 (CC0) training recordings of obt-body-v2: one camera per recording of 7 trainval subjects. Not used: the 3 official test subjects (3D benchmark) and 5 trainval subjects kept for development and evaluation (refused_actors). Order matters (sampling indices).

excluded.reason: bone-length/hip geometry gate (fewer than 64 frames, missing hips, or a bone shorter than 1.5 cm / longer than 1.5 m)
